item.title: Life Insurers Not Going Mobile, Risking Relevance
item.description: Life insurers are late to the digital game and missing out as consumers go mobile with finance.

item.title: Enrollment In Health-Sharing Ministries Skyrockets
item.description: Amid rising healthcare costs and premiums, more people are turning to health-sharing ministries as an alternative to insurance plans offered through the Affordable Care Act exchanges or employers. Still, these ministries have limited government oversight and have far more freedom to reject applicants with preexisting conditions or claims that don't meet moral standards.

item.title: Employees Turn Away From High-Deductible Health Plans: Report
item.description: Employers are offering more high-deductible health plans and voluntary income protection products to their benefits, but fewer employees are enrolling as costs rise for those plans, too.
